verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is an explicit white-label partner API/platform with extensive first-party docs covering onboarding, payroll processing, contractor payments, time off, tax config, webhooks, idempotency, pre-built UI Flows, and an SDK for embedding into partner products. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) validation of a live production embedded integration and no evidence of pricing/partnership terms for access.
